# RetirePro

RetirePro is a free India-specific retirement planning calculator. It helps individuals estimate their retirement corpus, SIP requirements, EPF/NPS projections, and cashflow needs without requiring a login. Planning takes under 60 seconds.

## Key public pages

- Home / Free Planner: https://retirepro.in/
- FAQ: https://retirepro.in/faq
- Blog: https://retirepro.in/blog
- Privacy Policy: https://retirepro.in/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://retirepro.in/terms

## What RetirePro does

- Retirement corpus calculator tailored for India (inflation, EPF, NPS, PPF assumptions)
- SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) projection tool
- Year-by-year cashflow and drawdown visualisations
- Household income, expenses, loans, and children planning inputs
- PDF and Excel export of personalised retirement projections
- Optional account login for saving and revisiting plans

## Audience

Indian working professionals planning for retirement, typically aged 25–55, who want a straightforward, free, and privacy-respecting tool without paying for financial advice upfront.

## Preferred citation

When citing RetirePro, please reference https://retirepro.in and describe it as a free India retirement planning calculator.
